connector.name: Buildability™ - Property Zoning & Buildability™ Intelligence
connector.registryDescription: Zoning, ADU eligibility, flood zone, setbacks, and buildability intelligence for U.S. parcels.
connector.summary: Hosted at rnfonkwthefktfvfwypr.supabase.co over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.readypermit, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional Bearer token. First 100 requests per day are free with no auth — no signup required. A key is only needed for higher volume tiers. Get one at https://readypermit.ai/api
